description: This file contains Makefile snippets and macro definitions related to building root filesystem images, including conditional logic for MKLIBS, package management commands (opkg, apk), and root filesystem preparation steps.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines a macro to build and strip libraries using mklibs, including finding executables and shared objects, and copying them to target directories.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines a macro for installing packages with opkg, with options for offline root, architecture, and other configurations.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Defines a macro for installing packages with apk, specifying root, keys, and environment preservation.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Defines a macro to clean up opkg package info files and status, removing unnecessary files and updating status files.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Defines a macro to prepare the root filesystem, including copying files, running post-install scripts, enabling/disabling init scripts, cleaning up version control directories, and invoking other macros.
